title: RUST_CODE.BBS · The banner
venue: Arthur's site · drawn during Message Boards · never posted
logline: The garage's monitor one night shows a board Wood didn't dial: a banner in phosphor green — WELCOME TO a name, a frontier, ACTIVE NODES: 64 — and the stick chorus on the desk reading it with him. The strip draws the banner as shapes. The chorus can read it. Wood can't.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at the beige computer. The screen: a gray rectangle with a banner of green blocks across its top. The stick chorus on the desk.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man at a beige computer whose screen shows a banner of green blocks across the top, tiny stick figures on the desk

panels.composition: The banner, close: three lines of green blocks, a number at the end drawn as two shapes.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close on a computer screen with three lines of phosphor-green blocks and a two-digit number drawn as shapes at the end

panels.composition: The chorus reading it, one pointing, tiny balloons blank.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, tiny stick figures on a desk pointing at a screen with tiny empty speech balloons
brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man at a computer speaking down to tiny stick figures on his desk

art.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; the stick figures in ballpoint; the screen as a gray rectangle with a banner in it
art.palette: muddy early-digital flats; the screen's phosphor green, once

notes: RUST_CODE.BBS (Vols 5–7: the network's in-fiction name). ACTIVE NODES: 64, as shapes. The chorus can read it.
